name: Istorija Samanty: Bilet v Nikuda
source: Semyon and Samantha are heading to Moscow. Everything would be fine, were it not for Semyon's constant nightmares. No one knows how this will end, but one thing is clear: something is not right here...
translation: 谢苗和萨曼莎正前往莫斯科。要不是谢苗经常做噩梦，一切都会好起来的。没有人知道这将如何结束，但有一件事是明确的：这里有些不对劲……
